# TEC INDUSTRIES

TEC INDUSTRIES is an Indian manufacturer of industrial-grade piping systems, based in Vapi, Gujarat, with pan-India delivery. Core products: PPR Pipe & Fittings, HDPE Pipe & Fittings, Electrofusion Fittings, Industrial Valves, Pipe Support Systems, and PPR Fusion Machines.

## Business
TEC INDUSTRIES supplies PPR (20–160 mm, PN10/PN16/PN20/PN25) and HDPE (20–630 mm) piping to chemical, pharmaceutical, municipal, infrastructure, and industrial clients. Manufactured to IS 15801 / ISO 15874 / DIN 8077. Direct-from-manufacturer pricing, dealer partnerships, and project quotations available.
